items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I'll go on record as saying that Charlie Parker influenced all the musicians... Charlie Parker influenced everyone who ever played jazz

ctx.x: You know, you've got to be pretty slick to read it, you know, just like I heard this group of saxophone players that were trying to play Charlie Parker's music, his solos. His solos are hard enough to play by themselves, much less harmonize them and play one of Charlie Parker's solos in five-part harmony, that's --
